LeadInquiry.title: LeadInquiry
LeadInquiry.description: Client project inquiry or sample request submitted via website contact form

name.description: Full name or studio name of the photographer/client

whatsapp.description: Phone or WhatsApp number with international country code

projectType.description: Type of service requested (e.g. Wedding Album Design, Photo Retouching)

requestFreeSample.description: Flag indicating if client requested a complimentary test retouching frame

samplePhotosLink.description: Optional cloud storage link (Google Drive, Dropbox, WeTransfer)

DataSubjectRequest.description: GDPR/TCPA user preference, WhatsApp opt-out, data export, or erasure request

email.description: Client email associated with the inquiry

whatsapp.description: Phone number for WhatsApp opt-out verification

requestType.description: Type of request (WHATSAPP_OPT_OUT, DATA_EXPORT, RIGHT_TO_BE_FORGOTTEN, COMMUNICATION_PREFERENCE)

details.description: Specific instructions or additional context from client
